correctness.rationale: For permutations on six symbols, distance at least four is exactly disjointness of ordered three-subsequence masks. Exhaustive scans of all 720 permutations find 132 identity-compatible words, 298 four-word codes containing identity, no extending fifth word, and 57 canonical classes. Two distinct algorithms agree on the full classification; a third expands all 720 alphabet relabelings to 53,640 labeled sets. The double count 4N=720·298 and the eight-choice canonicalization justify all counts. Erdős–Szekeres eliminates distance-five pairs in any three-word code.

Complete canonical classification into 57 classes and the exact 53,640 labeled-code count are not implications of that size theorem. The 2022/23 complete-covering PSCA(6,3) work concerns uniform incidence rather than a four-permutation partial packing. The 1999 directed-design paper remains a named, incompletely inspected bibliographic risk.

value.rationale: The natural first non-Singleton Ulam code at n=6,d=4 has a previously tabulated maximum size but no equality classification in the inspected original full text. The exact 57 symmetry types, 53,640 labeled optima, and stabilizer-profile/orbit-size trichotomy describe a complete, meaningful family of extremal rank-modulation designs; this is not a routine recomputation of the known optimum.
